title: Thirst Draft: Write Drunk, Edit Never
synopsis:
An event for writers — and for writing. Everyone gets the same prompt when they walk in the door. What ends up on the page is up to you!
Here’s how it works:
Write whatever you want — poem, song, short story, joke… anything works!
Interpret the prompt however you like, but try to incorporate it in some way
Work alone or collaborate with friends/strangers — no word count or time limit
Sign up by 7pm if you want to share your piece on stage, just like an open mic
Want to join, but can’t make it by 6 pm? All good!
Here are some loose times to keep in mind:
Write & Mingle: 6pm to 7pm
Share on Stage: 7pm to 8pm
Drink & Discuss: 8pm to 9pm
No cover, no editing, no AI. Pens and paper will be available, but bring your own if you can. Tip your bartenders and support your fellow writers.

title: Huney Knuckles
synopsis:
HUGE NOISE, world class musicianship, mind-bending solos, and uber funky jams
Kevin Wong, Darian Gray, Tony Peebles & Bian Sheu
9pm-12:30am / $7
The newest kids on the block, the Huney Knuckles (formerly the Black Star Pirates) combines the left hand keyboard bass wizardry of Kevin Wong with the indomitable pocket of Darian Gray, touring drummer for Booker T Jones for the past 14 years. Founded in early 2021, the Huney Knuckles were birthed during the quarantine at Black Star Pirate BBQ when they teamed up with Grammy winning saxophonist Tony Peebles & Virtuoso guitarist Brian Sheu to bring the joy of live music to one of the first places in town to host socially distanced outdoor live music. Fusing watertight grooves with high energy shreds that will make you want to jump out of your seat, this 4-piece has made a huge noise in the local scene, drawing new fans left & right at every show with their world class musicianship, mind-bending solos, and uber-funky jams.

title: Thick & Tired (A Drag Show)
synopsis:
